FN-4UBFPRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 511
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/02/2026
House Bill 511 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, could
reduce funding to local public K-12 boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent
on the amount of funds that are withheld for failure to recite the Pledge of Allegiance and fail to
vote on a policy that would provide an opportunity for a period of prayer and reading of the
Bible or other religious text as provided by this bill.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2027.
Page 1

FN-4UBFPRR-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 511
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/05/2026
House Bill 511 as reported by the Committee on State Government proposes a constitutional
amendment which, if ratified, could reduce funding to local public K-12 boards of education by
an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of funds that are withheld for failure of the
local board to adopt a policy that requires the public schools under its jurisdiction to conduct the
Pledge of Allegiance and conduct a prayer at the commencement of the first class each school
day.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2027.
Page 1

FN-4UBFPRR-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 511
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/13/2026
House Bill 511 as passed the House of Representatives proposes a constitutional amendment
which, if ratified, would require local boards of education to adopt policies requiring each public
K-12 school under its jurisdiction to conduct the Pledge of Allegiance at the beginning of the
school day and to allow prayer to be conducted pursuant to the provision of this amendment.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
